caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four drawers, each featuring two ornate brass handles and a central brass keyhole plate. The chest is a rich brown color, indicating a wood grain pattern throughout its surface, and the brass hardware stands out with a golden-yellow hue. The top section of the chest has a slanted, hinged lid, suggesting a desk or secretary design, with additional brass fixtures attached. The chest stands on short, bracket feet, and the overall form is rectangular with slightly beveled edges. The object is centered on a plain, light beige background, and there is a handwritten name, "Carl Buergermiss," near the bottom right.
title: Writing Desk
